description: Buy a Dimore d'Epoca digital gift card (EUR 20-3000, valid 12 months on all properties and experiences of the collection). Returns a Stripe payment link for the buyer; after payment the gift card (code + PDF) is emailed to the buyer and, if given, to the recipient on the chosen date.

delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optional, to schedule the email to the recipient (e.g. a birthday).

recipient_email.description: If given, the card is emailed to the recipient; otherwise only to the buyer, ready to print.

name: buy_gift_card
